[[File:Mikey.png|thumb|250px|Mikey]] '''Mikey''' (Japanese: '''タイチ''' ''Taichi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP040|The Battling Eevee Brothers]]''. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== All of Mikey's [[Eevee brothers|brothers]] fought over how Mikey should [[Evolution|evolve]] his {{p|Eevee}}. Despite the fact that all of his brothers wanted to see him train an [[Eeveelution]] as well, he preferred keeping his Eevee just the way it was. However, he did not have the courage to tell his older brothers this. Eventually, after some advice from {{an|Misty}}, who related to Mikey since she is the youngest of four sisters, he decided to try anyway. His brothers eventually came to accept Mikey's choice after witnessing Eevee battle {{TRT}} and emerge victorious. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Mikey |pkmn=Eevee |type1=Normal |img=Mikey Eevee.png |epnum=EP040 |epname=The Battling Eevee Brothers |vajp=Rikako Aikawa |vaen=Rikako Aikawa |desc=Mikey trained an {{p|Eevee}}, which appeared in ''[[EP040|The Battling Eevee Brothers]]''. At first, Mikey was too embarrassed of what his brothers may think, but later, he found out it was his choice to evolve it. It first appeared in a nearby forest, where {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} found it tied up inside a hollow tree with just [[Pokémon food|food]] and water. Using its collar, they found out that it lives in [[Stone Town]], so {{an|Misty}} picked it up to find its real owner. They found the [[Eevee brothers]], who told them their younger brother Mikey was the owner. It eventually found Mikey. It was then revealed that the brothers wanted Mikey to evolve his Eevee into its different forms; he didn't want to evolve it and tried to hide it. Misty told him to stand up to his brothers about how he feels. Suddenly, {{TRT}} appeared and stole it and all of the other Pokémon, as well as [[Evolution stone]]s. The group eventually found Team Rocket by following the ink trail [[Misty's Horsea]] left behind and were able to free all of the Pokémon before sending Team Rocket blasting off. After the battle, Mikey told his brothers that he did not want to evolve Eevee, and his brothers understood that it was his choice. It was last seen in a picture. Eevee's known moves are {{m|Tackle}} and {{m|Take Down}}.}} ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=冬馬由美 ''[[Yumi Touma]]'' |it=Federica Valenti (Mediaset dub)
Stefano Pozzi (K2 dub) |en=[[Kayzie Rogers]] |ar=امال سعد الدين ''Amal Saad Eddin'' |fi=Jenni Sivonen |no=Katrine Blomstrand |pl=Renata Berger |pt_br=Thelma Lúcia |es_eu=Chelo Vivares |es_la=Ana Lobo}} ==In the manga== [[File:Mikey EToP.png|thumb|150px|Mikey in [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]]]] ===The Electric Tale of Pikachu=== Mikey appeared in ''[[ET06|To Evolve or Not to Evolve, That Is the Question!]]''. His desire was to join the [[Knights of the E Stone]], just like his brothers, but was denied due to him not having evolved his Eevee. {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|EToP|Ash}} defeated Pyro and Rainer for him, but Sparky demanded to battle Mikey himself. During their battle, Ash took a time-out in order to use a [[TM]] to teach Eevee {{m|Mimic}}, allowing it to defeat Sparky's {{p|Jolteon}} and thus allow Mikey to join the Knights of the E Stone. In ''[[ET12|Welcome to the Big Leagues]]'', Mikey was seen watching the [[Indigo Plateau]] [[Pokémon League]] on his television. ====Pokémon==== {{anchor|Eevee 2}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Mikey |width=80 |pkmn=Eevee |type1=Normal |img=Mikey Eevee EToP.png |epnum=ET06 |epname=To Evolve or Not to Evolve, That Is the Question! |desc=Mikey owns an {{p|Eevee}}, like in the animated series. He used it to defeat Sparky's {{p|Jolteon}} in battle. Eevee's known moves are {{m|Tackle}}, {{m|Reflect}}, and {{m|Mimic}}.
